_what: this component's Learning Block spec — the data the uniform engine (cairn/machines/learning_block/engine.py) is instantiated from; ticket engine-runs-one-block, first tenant chosen by measurement at the chart's survey berth (16 training traces, no tie, 2026-08-02)
_why: the reasoning behind a gate poke used to live nowhere: the trace said 'copy_to_lab' fired and a reader had to re-derive why regenerating whole beats copying incrementally every time the question came up. With the spec as data, one engine run leaves the whole argument — candidates, killers, winner's why — in a record a small model (or a compiled floor) can read back.
question: a poke landed at the recompile gate — which op does the lab actually need?

input_contract.staleness: the measured state of the lab against its sources ('stale' or 'current') — the fact every candidate is judged against; an unmeasured claim is a hypothesis, not an input (Law 3)

candidates.name: no_op
candidates.why: the cheapest true answer: a lab already matching its sources needs nothing — re-deriving the settled is the defect (Law 1)

candidates.name: copy_stale_only
candidates.why: the tempting incremental: copy only sources newer than their lab copy — cheaper than whole regeneration on a big tree

candidates.name: regenerate_whole
candidates.why: what copy_to_lab does: gather every intention, copy each, delete orphans — the lab regenerated whole so nothing carries over

constraints.name: matches_measured_staleness
constraints.why: Akien reads the lab as the current model of every intention; an op correct only for the state the world is NOT in leaves the next /intent consult reading intentions that no longer exist — the exact drift the read-refresh poke was built to stop

constraints.name: no_stale_carry_over
constraints.why: 'A copy whose source is gone is DELETED on the next run, so a removed intention removes its copy — no stale carry-over' — an op that cannot see a vanished source leaves its copy lying to every later reader, and the lab claims it can regrow the system

escalation: akien, the gate's owner — no candidate op can honestly serve the measured state, so the compiler's own contract is in question, and that is a spec change, not an op choice
